sources.entry: OpenProject - Manage your projects, tasks and goals. Collaborate via work packages and link them to your pull requests on Github. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Ruby/deb/Docker
OpenProject | Project management software for classic, agile and hybrid teams

summary.one_liner: OpenProject is a self-hostable, web-based open source project management application for planning projects, tasks, agile workflows and team collaboration.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a web application for managing projects, portfolios, products, tasks and bugs, with support for agile boards, Kanban, Scrum and SAFe. It lists Gantt-chart project planning and scheduling, product and release planning, time tracking, cost reporting and budgeting. Team collaboration features mentioned include wikis, forums, news, meeting agendas and meeting minutes. It names integrations with Nextcloud, XWiki, GitHub and GitLab, and the awesome-list metadata notes linking work packages to GitHub pull requests. The README points to a Community edition that is free to self-host and a paid Enterprise edition with cloud or on-premises options.
use_cases: bug and issue tracking for teams
team wikis, meeting minutes and agendas
linking tasks to GitHub or GitLab work
how_to_run: Download the Community edition from the OpenProject website
Follow the in-depth installation guides referenced in the README for production or evaluation use
notable: Covers agile (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), waterfall-style Gantt planning and bug tracking in one tool
Integrations named in the README include Nextcloud, XWiki, GitHub and GitLab
Community edition is free; Enterprise edition adds support and add-ons
Positioned as a self-hosted alternative to Jira, MS Project, Monday, Asana and YouTrack
caveats: Enterprise edition, support and add-ons are paid; the README points to paid tiers and a 14-day free trial
The README does not describe install requirements beyond pointing to the installation guides
